canDo: Can write a linear but complete opinion essay: position, two reasons, an example, a concession, a conclusion.
review: Review connectors, comparison, cause and effect.
input: Read a short prompt text and extract only the topic.
checkpoint: At least 2 body paragraphs; the conclusion brings in no new argument.
challenge: Today’s challenge: find a controversial social issue in RFI’s « Journal en français facile » or TV5MONDE Apprendre B1 (e.g. Sunday shop opening, office dress codes) and write a ≥160-word opinion essay in 45 minutes: position + two reasons + one concrete example + a concession + a conclusion; use the subjunctive at least 2 times (il faut que, bien que, je souhaite que), then count the words and underline every connector.

questions.why: 54% versus 39%, and « Les réponses varient fortement selon la situation professionnelle ».
The mechanism given is that crowding spreads disease between birds and concentrates droppings.
« Au début j'étais contre, je ne vais pas le cacher »; the change came from the park-and-ride and the shuttle.
The text gives exactly this combination of three elements.
